title: Install + restart sutra MCP server to activate hierarchical alias schema (sutra/321) and frozen-alias sync (sutra/320)
description:
sutra/320 (frozen alias sync marker, a10913b) and sutra/321 (hierarchical alias schema, 7e25bab) are committed but NOT live — the running sutra MCP server is still the old binary. Until install + server restart:
- migration 0062 hasn't run against the live kala-reverse index.db (still flat aliases schema),
- sutra_explore("deg_to_rashi") / ("positions") against the live kala-reverse workspace still return 0.

Verified working on a copy of the index (see sutra/321 execution_record). Action: rebuild+install the sutra binary, restart the MCP server, then confirm live sutra_explore("deg_to_rashi")->FUN_008d1c50 and sutra_explore("positions")-> member symbols in the real kala-reverse workspace. Note the current branch is unmerged.
execution_record: Josh rebuilt/installed the sutra binary and restarted the MCP server, activating sutra/320 (frozen alias sync) and sutra/321 (hierarchical alias schema). Migration 0062 now applied to the live kala-reverse index; forward alias resolution live.
